title: Tailwise Autoship Subscriber Credit on Returnless Damage Credits
content:
**Member benefit statement - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

A returnless damage credit carries a subscriber credit that counts whole months since the enrollment date of the customer's active Tailwise Autoship subscription.

- 36 whole months or more: $1.50.
- 12 whole months or more, but fewer than 36: $0.75.
- A shorter run, or no active Autoship subscription: nothing.

A month counts as whole once the day of the month of the enrollment date is reached again. Only a subscription in status active on the Tailwise Autoship record is read.

| Hypothetical enrollment date (today 2026-09-01) | Whole months | Subscriber credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2023-09-02 | 35 | $0.75 |
| 2023-09-01 | 36 | $1.50 |
| 2025-09-02 | 11 | Nothing |
| 2025-09-01 | 12 | $0.75 |
| No active subscription | - | Nothing |
